verdict.text: Fails to launch when built with the iOS 27 SDK.

findings.title: No scene configuration
findings.message: Info.plist has no UIApplicationSceneManifest, and AppDelegate does not implement application(_:configurationForConnecting:options:). Built with the iOS 27 SDK, the app stops at launch: "UIScene life cycle is required for apps built with this SDK". Flutter will not migrate it automatically: ios/Runner/AppDelegate.swift differs from the templates Flutter migrates.

fix.title: Migrate the Flutter app by hand
steps: Conform AppDelegate to FlutterImplicitEngineDelegate and move GeneratedPluginRegistrant.register, method channels and platform views into didInitializeImplicitFlutterEngine(_:).
Add UIApplicationSceneManifest to ios/Runner/Info.plist with a configuration whose UISceneDelegateClassName is FlutterSceneDelegate and UISceneStoryboardFile is Main.

sources.title: Flutter: UIScene adoption (Migrate AppDelegate, Migrate Info.plist)
Apple: Transitioning to the UIKit scene-based life cycle

findings.title: application(_:open:options:) is not called with scenes
findings.message: UIKit does not call this method once the app uses scenes. Use scene(_:openURLContexts:), and connectionOptions.urlContexts in scene(_:willConnectTo:options:) for a link that launches the app.

fix.title: Handle it in a FlutterSceneDelegate subclass
steps: Create SceneDelegate: FlutterSceneDelegate, name it in UISceneDelegateClassName, and override the scene delegate method named in the finding, calling super so plugins still receive the event.

findings.title: Root view controller read from the app delegate's window
findings.message: UIKit does not set the app delegate's window once a scene owns the window, and application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:) runs before any scene connects; reading its root view controller finds nil, and a forced cast of it crashes.

fix.title: Create channels from the engine bridge
steps: Create method channels in didInitializeImplicitFlutterEngine(_:) with engineBridge.applicationRegistrar.messenger() instead of reading window?.rootViewController.
